sentences.zh: 33位总统。

sentences.en: I called the president at 4.30 in the morning and he answered.
sentences.zh: 我凌晨4点半给总统打了电话，他接了。

sentences.en: Seven decades in space.
sentences.zh: 七十年的太空探索。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗恒星之外有什么。

sentences.en: A thousand consumer product guides.
sentences.zh: 一千份消费品指南。

sentences.en: Today I am testing seven mattresses.
sentences.zh: 今天我正在测试七款床垫。

sentences.en: 60 super sundaes.
sentences.zh: 60份超级圣代。

sentences.en: They were probably the best team in the league every single year.
sentences.zh: 他们可能每年都是联盟里最强的球队。

sentences.en: 53,500 puzzles.
I use a different starting word every day.
sentences.zh: 我每天都用不同的起始词。

sentences.en: 25,000 recipes.
And I love a one pan recipe because I don't love washing pans.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢一锅出的食谱，因为我不喜欢洗锅。

sentences.en: The New York Times, celebrating 175 years of helping you understand the world and make the most of each day.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》，庆祝175年来一直致力于帮助您了解世界并充分利用每一天。

sentences.en: Subscribe now for a special offer at nytimes.com slash subscribe.
sentences.zh: 立即订阅，获取nytimes.com/subscribe上的特别优惠。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》节目。

sentences.en: The race for the White House has kicked into overdrive tonight with a tax...
sentences.zh: 今晚，白宫之争进入了白热化阶段，一项税收……

sentences.en: As the presidential race enters its final 45 days.
sentences.zh: 随着总统竞选进入最后45天。

sentences.en: Hello, Pennsylvania.
sentences.zh: 你好，宾夕法尼亚州。

sentences.en: How are we doing, Pennsylvania?
sentences.zh: 宾夕法尼亚州，你们好吗？

sentences.en: We assemble a campaign roundtable with my colleagues from the politics desk.
sentences.zh: 我们召集了一个竞选圆桌会议，与我在政治新闻部的同事们一起讨论。

sentences.en: Today, Maggie Haberman, Shane Goldbacher, and Nate Cohn make sense of the week's biggest developments.
sentences.zh: 今天，玛吉·哈伯曼、谢恩·戈德巴赫和内特·科恩将为您解读本周最大的进展。

sentences.en: The Federal Reserve cut interest rates today for the first time in four years.
sentences.zh: 美联储今天四年来首次下调了利率。

sentences.en: You know, the Democrats have always taken for granted that they're going to get our vote no matter what.
sentences.zh: 你知道，民主党人一直认为无论如何我们都会投票给他们，这是理所当然的。

sentences.en: And the Republicans are fancying themselves as the working people's party.
sentences.zh: 而共和党人则自诩为工薪阶层的政党。

sentences.en: Former President Trump has now faced two apparent assassination attempts.
sentences.zh: 前总统特朗普现在已经遭遇了两次明显的暗杀企图。

sentences.en: It's sort of mind-boggling...
sentences.zh: 这简直令人难以置信……

sentences.en: It's Friday, September 20th.
sentences.zh: 今天是9月20日，星期五。

sentences.en: Maggie, Shane, Nate, thank you all for doing this.
sentences.zh: 玛吉、谢恩、内特，谢谢你们参加这次讨论。

sentences.en: Thank you for having us.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请我们。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So just to explain what we're doing here,
sentences.zh: 那么，先解释一下我们在这里要做什么，

sentences.en: it feels like we've reached the point in this campaign where the news is coming at us so fast that our normal format of telling one story a day is not quite keeping up.
sentences.zh: 感觉我们已经到了竞选的这个阶段，新闻来得太快，以至于我们每天讲一个故事的常规形式已经跟不上了。

sentences.en: And so to meet this moment, we recruited you three to come kind of walk us through the thicket that is the news at this phase of the race.
sentences.zh: 为了应对这一时刻，我们邀请了你们三位来带我们梳理一下竞选现阶段错综复杂的新闻。

sentences.en: So it's an experiment for us.
sentences.zh: 所以这对我们来说是一次实验。

sentences.en: We invented something.
sentences.zh: 我们发明了一些新东西。

sentences.en: It's brand new.
sentences.zh: 它是全新的。

sentences.en: It's called the Political Roundtable.
sentences.zh: 它叫“政治圆桌会议”。

sentences.en: Congratulations.
sentences.zh: 恭喜。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: What an honor to be part of the firSt.
sentences.zh: 能参加第一次会议真是荣幸。

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah, yeah, yeah, yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊，是啊，是啊，是啊，是啊。

sentences.en: The first of any kind.
sentences.zh: 任何种类的第一次。

sentences.en: Ever.
sentences.zh: 有史以来。

sentences.en: No, ever, ever, ever.
sentences.zh: 不，是有史以来，有史以来，有史以来。

sentences.en: Yes, in history.
sentences.zh: 是的，在历史上。

sentences.en: So let's start with a very big new poll co-conducted by the New York Times that came out just a few hours ago.
sentences.zh: 那么，让我们从几个小时前刚刚发布的一项由《纽约时报》联合开展的非常重大的新民调开始吧。

sentences.en: Could each of you just tell me what you took from this poll?
sentences.zh: 你们每一个人能告诉我你们从这份民调中得出了什么结论吗？

sentences.en: I think that this is a poll, there's actually two polls, and there's some contradiction between the two of them.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是一份民调，实际上是两份民调，而且两者之间存在一些矛盾。

sentences.en: The first poll is a national poll, and it shows a tied race, which isn't really a surprise.
sentences.zh: 第一份是全国性民调，显示选情胶着，这其实并不令人惊讶。

sentences.en: And it shows no movement, basically, since the debate a week ago, even though voters overwhelmingly said that Kamala Harris performed really, really well.
sentences.zh: 而且显示基本没有变化，自一周前的辩论以来，尽管选民们压倒性地认为卡玛拉·哈里斯表现得非常好。

sentences.en: So that's the first part of the poll.
sentences.zh: 所以这是民调的第一部分。

sentences.en: Is that worth lingering on, that people told us in this poll Kamala Harris did great?
sentences.zh: 值得深究的是，人们在这份民调中告诉我们卡玛拉·哈里斯表现得很棒吗？

sentences.en: It had been our understanding that if she did great, she'd get a bump in the polls.
sentences.zh: 我们之前的理解是，如果她表现出色，她的民调支持率会上升。

sentences.en: Nationally, she doesn't.
sentences.zh: 在全国范围内，她并没有上升。

sentences.en: Yeah, I think that's definitely worth lingering on.
sentences.zh: 是的，我认为这绝对值得深究。

sentences.en: And the fact is that overwhelmingly voters said she did really well.
sentences.zh: 事实是，绝大多数选民表示她表现得非常好。

sentences.en: If something close to 70% of voters said she performed well in this debate, far more than the 40% who said the same of Trump,
sentences.zh: 如果接近70%的选民说她在这次辩论中表现出色，远高于说特朗普表现出色的40%，

sentences.en: that means a big chunk of people who said she did well are not voting for her.
sentences.zh: 这意味着很大一部分说她表现出色的人并不打算投票给她。

sentences.en: But that's also part of the story, which is that she might have done better in the debate,
sentences.zh: 但这也是故事的一部分，那就是她可能在辩论中表现得更好，

sentences.en: but it didn't actually change how people said they were planning to vote in the head-to-head matchup with Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 但这并没有真正改变人们在与唐纳德·特朗普的直接对决中计划投票的方式。

sentences.en: And it wasn't just on that top line, who are you going to vote for?
sentences.zh: 而且不仅仅是在那个最顶层的“你会投票给谁”的问题上。

sentences.en: It was on a whole suite of issues.
sentences.zh: 而是在一系列议题上。

sentences.en: Who do you think is better on the economy, on immigration, on abortion, on democracy?
sentences.zh: 你认为谁在经济、移民、堕胎、民主问题上表现更好？

sentences.en: All of these issues were essentially unchanged by this debate that was watched by 67 million Americans, the most who watched anything since the Super Bowl.
sentences.zh: 所有这些议题基本上都没有因为这场有6700万美国人观看的辩论而改变，这是自超级碗以来观看人数最多的一次。

sentences.en: And yet, no difference in the head-to-head report.
sentences.zh: 然而，直接对决的报告没有任何差异。

sentences.en: Why not, Nate?
sentences.zh: 为什么呢，内特？

sentences.en: Well, it's a pretty polarized country, and the number of undecided voters did tick down from our previous poll to this one.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这是一个相当两极分化的国家，未决定选民的数量确实比我们之前的民调有所下降。

sentences.en: So a lot of voters are making up their minds, and they're mostly falling into the place where they were before.
sentences.zh: 所以很多选民正在下定决心，他们大多回到了之前的位置。

sentences.en: This is a matchup that neatly divides voters in a lot of ways.
sentences.zh: 这是一场在很多方面都将选民清晰划分的对决。

sentences.en: We have a populist, older, white, conservative against a younger, black, and South Asian woman from California who has liberal views on all the issues.
sentences.zh: 我们有一位民粹主义的、年长的、白人保守派，对抗一位来自加利福尼亚州的、年轻的、黑人和南亚裔女性，她在所有议题上都持有自由派观点。

sentences.en: So, you know, there is room for someone to be torn between these two options.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，确实有让人在这两个选项之间纠结的空间。

sentences.en: But as far as choices go, this is a relatively clear one.
sentences.zh: 但就选择而言，这是一个相对明确的选择。

sentences.en: Okay, but this poll did something else, which was it told us about how Kamala Harris is doing in the very specific crucial state, Maggie, of Pennsylvania.
sentences.zh: 好吧，但这份民调还做了另一件事，那就是它告诉了我们卡玛拉·哈里斯在那个非常具体、至关重要的州——宾夕法尼亚州——的表现，玛吉。

sentences.en: What do you take from that result?
sentences.zh: 你从那个结果中得出了什么结论？

sentences.en: What's striking, and as Shane said, is it's contradictory to what we saw in the national poll where they're tied.
sentences.zh: 引人注目的是，正如谢恩所说，这与我们在全国民调中看到的他们势均力敌的情况相矛盾。

sentences.en: She's up.
sentences.zh: 她领先。

sentences.en: It's 50 to 46.
In Pennsylvania.
sentences.zh: 在宾夕法尼亚州。

sentences.en: In Pennsylvania.
sentences.zh: 在宾夕法尼亚州。

sentences.en: And one of the reasons that might be is the Democrats have done relatively better with white voters this cycle than in previous cycles.
sentences.zh: 原因之一可能是民主党人在本周期中与白人选民的表现比以往周期相对更好。

sentences.en: And Pennsylvania is a particularly white state compared to the rest of the country.
sentences.zh: 而且与全国其他地区相比，宾夕法尼亚州是一个特别“白”的州。

sentences.en: And so if you look at how Joe Biden did with white voters in 2020, it was slightly less.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你看看乔·拜登在2020年与白人选民的表现，稍微少了一点。

sentences.en: Hillary Clinton, substantially less.
sentences.zh: 希拉里·克林顿则少得多。

sentences.en: And so if she has made some modest gains there, that could be why.
sentences.zh: 所以如果她在那里取得了一些适度的增长，那可能就是原因。

sentences.en: Huh.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Does that feel right to you, Nate?
sentences.zh: 内特，你觉得这合理吗？

sentences.en: Because I think my inclination would be to think that if Kamala Harris is tied with Trump nationally,
sentences.zh: 因为我想我的倾向会认为，如果卡玛拉·哈里斯在全国范围内与特朗普势均力敌，

sentences.en: I would not expect her to be doing better in a swing state where I would just imagine demographically things might be stacked a little bit against her.
sentences.zh: 我不会指望她在摇摆州表现得更好，因为我本能地认为从人口统计学上讲，情况可能对她稍微不利。

sentences.en: Look, I wouldn't expect it either.
sentences.zh: 看，我也不会指望。

sentences.en: And, you know, they are polls.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，它们只是民调。

sentences.en: They're subject to a margin of error.
sentences.zh: 它们存在误差范围。

sentences.en: It's possible that if we did the polls again that they would come a little closer.
sentences.zh: 如果我们再做一次民调，它们可能会更接近一些，这是可能的。

sentences.en: But this doesn't come from nowhere.
sentences.zh: 但这并非空穴来风。

sentences.en: In the 2022 midterm, Democrats swept the key Senate races, including winning Pennsylvania by five points, even while Republicans won the House popular vote.
sentences.zh: 在2022年的中期选举中，民主党横扫了关键的参议院竞选，包括以五个百分点的优势赢得了宾夕法尼亚州，尽管共和党赢得了众议院的普选票。

sentences.en: So there could be a change from the last election, maybe not all the way to this poll result where Harris does four points better in Pennsylvania than she does nationwide.
sentences.zh: 所以可能与上次选举相比有所变化，也许不会完全达到哈里斯在宾夕法尼亚州比在全国范围内好四个百分点的民调结果。

sentences.en: But one where the gap between the key battleground states and the Electoral College is a little smaller than we're used to.
sentences.zh: 但关键战场州与选举人团之间的差距可能比我们习惯的要小一些。

sentences.en: But I was just going to say, I mean, there's like two stories you can tell about the race right now that I think that these polls capture.
sentences.zh: 但我正想说，我的意思是，关于现在的竞选，你可以讲两个故事，我认为这些民调捕捉到了这一点。

sentences.en: And we talk about how polls are a snapshot.
sentences.zh: 我们谈论民调是一个快照。

sentences.en: This snapshot shows a really close race nationally and maybe a slight edge for Kamala Harris, not just in Pennsylvania,
sentences.zh: 这个快照显示全国范围内选情非常胶着，卡玛拉·哈里斯可能略有优势，不仅是在宾夕法尼亚州，

sentences.en: but looking at other polls across those key battlegrounds around the Great Lakes.
sentences.zh: 而且看看五大湖周围那些关键战场州的其他民调也是如此。

sentences.en: And so how do you get the story of what that means next?
sentences.zh: 那么你如何得出接下来意味着什么的故事呢？

sentences.en: And it's not at all clear to me what it means next, because we got here and it's look, Kamala Harris just had an incredible two months, right?
sentences.zh: 对我来说，接下来意味着什么一点也不清楚，因为我们到了这一步，你看，卡玛拉·哈里斯刚刚度过了不可思议的两个月，对吧？

sentences.en: She's gotten almost exclusively positive reviews and coverage.
sentences.zh: 她几乎获得了完全正面的评价和报道。

sentences.en: She had a strong debate.
sentences.zh: 她进行了一场强有力的辩论。

sentences.en: Her favorability rating in Pennsylvania is above 50 percent.
sentences.zh: 她在宾夕法尼亚州的好感度超过了50%。

sentences.en: All these things are going in her favor.
sentences.zh: 所有这些事情都对她有利。

sentences.en: And yet you get all of that and she's tied and just maybe marginally ahead in these really, really important states.
sentences.zh: 然而你得到了所有这些，她还是势均力敌，在这些非常、非常重要的州里可能只是略微领先。

sentences.en: It's not just that she's had a great series of weeks, although she absolutely has.
sentences.zh: 不仅仅是她度过了很棒的几周，尽管她绝对是这样。

sentences.en: Trump's had a terrible series of days.
sentences.zh: 特朗普度过了糟糕的几天。

sentences.en: Trump had a debate in which he was spreading a baseless claim that Haitian immigrants in Springfield, Ohio, are eating pets and doubling down on that ever since.
sentences.zh: 特朗普进行了一场辩论，他在辩论中散布了一个毫无根据的说法，称俄亥俄州斯普林菲尔德的海地移民正在吃宠物，并且从那以后一直坚持这种说法。

sentences.en: He posted inexplicably on Truth Social, I hate Taylor Swift, who is an incredibly popular figure.
sentences.zh: 他在“真实社交”上莫名其妙地发帖说，我讨厌泰勒·斯威夫特，她是一个非常受欢迎的人物。

sentences.en: Yeah, a lot of people don't hate her.
sentences.zh: 是啊，很多人不讨厌她。

sentences.en: A lot of people don't hate her.
sentences.zh: 很多人不讨厌她。

sentences.en: And now he has done any number of self-destructive things while also facing one clear assassination attempt, one apparent assassination attempt.
sentences.zh: 现在他做了许多自我毁灭的事情，同时还面临一次明确的暗杀企图，一次明显的暗杀企图。

sentences.en: Normally speaking, a politician would get some measure of sympathy or voters feeling sorry for them or feeling more open to them.
sentences.zh: 通常来说，政客会得到某种程度的同情，或者选民会为他们感到难过，或者对他们更加开放。

sentences.en: And because of Trump's own behavior, he just does not.
sentences.zh: 但由于特朗普自己的行为，他并没有得到这些。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: Are you guys a little bit reigning on Kamala Harris's Pennsylvania parade?
sentences.zh: 你们是在给卡玛拉·哈里斯在宾夕法尼亚州的游行泼冷水吗？

sentences.en: Because I'm hearing, if I'm reading between the lines, you all say she's up in Pennsylvania but not that much.
sentences.zh: 因为我听到的，如果我从字里行间读懂的话，你们都说她在宾夕法尼亚州领先，但没有那么多。

sentences.en: And after a really great run, and Maggie, you're saying Trump's had a rough couple of days, so she could be up even more.
sentences.zh: 而且在经历了一段非常棒的时期之后，玛吉，你说特朗普度过了艰难的几天，所以她本可以领先更多。

sentences.en: Well, I think the poll shows that a lot of the vulnerabilities that we've talked about before are still there for Kamala Harris.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为民调显示，我们之前谈到的卡玛拉·哈里斯的许多弱点依然存在。

sentences.en: You know, in the last episode that I was with you on, we noted that more voters thought Harris was more of the same rather than change.
sentences.zh: 你知道，在我上次和你一起参加的节目中，我们注意到更多的选民认为哈里斯更多是“老调重弹”而不是“变革”。

sentences.en: And Harris has tried to pitch herself as a new generation of political leadership that can take the country in a new direction.
sentences.zh: 哈里斯试图将自己定位为能够带领国家走向新方向的新一代政治领导人。

sentences.en: But the poll still finds, even in Pennsylvania, that most voters think she's more of the same.
sentences.zh: 但民调仍然发现，即使在宾夕法尼亚州，大多数选民也认为她更多是“老调重弹”。

sentences.en: And most voters think Donald Trump is change.
sentences.zh: 而大多数选民认为唐纳德·特朗普是“变革”。

sentences.en: And to me, that just shows that she is swimming a little bit upstream in this election.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，这只是表明她在这次选举中有点逆水行舟。

sentences.en: One related issue here that may be another reason to rain a bit on Harris's parade is that Harris's strength in this poll comes out of white college graduates.
sentences.zh: 这里有一个相关的问题，可能是给哈里斯的游行泼冷水的另一个原因，那就是哈里斯在这份民调中的优势来自于白人大学毕业生。

sentences.en: She's still doing really poorly among white working class voters just as badly as Joe Biden did or worse than Joe Biden four years ago, both in Pennsylvania and nationwide.
sentences.zh: 她在白人蓝领选民中的表现依然非常糟糕，和四年前乔·拜登的表现一样差，甚至更糟，无论是在宾夕法尼亚州还是在全国范围内。

sentences.en: White college graduates, that's a different story.
sentences.zh: 白人大学毕业生，那是另一回事。

sentences.en: Now, they're somewhat insulated from the economy.
sentences.zh: 现在，他们对经济有某种程度的免疫力。

sentences.en: They may have the disposable income to survive rising prices.
sentences.zh: 他们可能有可支配收入来应对物价上涨。

sentences.en: But it's also, to me,
sentences.zh: 但对我来说，这也是，

sentences.en: a possible indication that maybe we're talking about a lot of overeager Democratic voters who are looking to pick up the phone right now after a debate and after a month where Harris fared really well.
sentences.zh: 一个可能的迹象，也许我们在谈论很多急切的民主党选民，他们在辩论后，在一个哈里斯表现非常好的月份后，正急于接听电话。

sentences.en: And that perhaps might explain why she's doing well in Pennsylvania, a state I think of as being very working class, having a lot of voters who didn't go to college.
sentences.zh: 这也许可以解释为什么她在宾夕法尼亚州表现良好，我认为这是一个非常蓝领的州，有很多没上过大学的选民。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: Something happened right before this poll, and that's that the Fed lowered the interest rate.
sentences.zh: 在这份民调之前发生了一件事，那就是美联储降低了利率。

sentences.en: Something we've been waiting for and talking about for a really long time.
sentences.zh: 这是我们等待并谈论了很长时间的事情。

sentences.en: In theory, that should make certain prices, especially the price of a 30-year fixed-rate mortgage, start to come down.
sentences.zh: 理论上，这应该会让某些价格，特别是30年期固定利率抵押贷款的价格开始下降。

sentences.en: When it comes to the economy and how voters view these two candidates, is that too little too late if you're Kamala Harris?
sentences.zh: 当谈到经济以及选民如何看待这两位候选人时，如果你是卡玛拉·哈里斯，这是否太少、太迟了？

sentences.en: Is that a frustrating bit of timing for Donald Trump, or does it not much matter at all?
sentences.zh: 这对唐纳德·特朗普来说是一个令人沮丧的时机，还是根本不重要？

sentences.en: I mean, Donald Trump was complaining about it as political yesterday, so it tells you how he sees it.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，唐纳德·特朗普昨天还在抱怨这是政治行为，所以这告诉你他是怎么看的。

sentences.en: He's clearly frustrated and thinks that it might help Democrats.
sentences.zh: 他显然很沮丧，认为这可能会帮助民主党人。

sentences.en: And could it help Harris?
sentences.zh: 这能帮助哈里斯吗？

sentences.en: Sure, it could help Harris.
sentences.zh: 当然，这可以帮助哈里斯。

sentences.en: But I think you are going to see Trump and Republicans claim that this was some form of interference by Democrats.
sentences.zh: 但我认为你会看到特朗普和共和党人声称这是民主党人某种形式的干预。

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, I think that the interest rates lead to changes in some of the few economic numbers that people experience in their life, right?
sentences.zh: 是的，我的意思是，我认为利率会导致人们生活中体验到的少数几个经济数字发生变化，对吧？

sentences.en: This is the kind of thing that it juices the economy in a way that, like, people don't see immediately, but it can change how people feel.
sentences.zh: 这是一种以人们不会立即看到的方式刺激经济的事情，但它可以改变人们的感受。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I think it's going to take a bit of time.
sentences.zh: 我想这还需要一点时间。

sentences.en: In Pennsylvania, only 22% of voters thought the economy was excellent or good in this survey.
sentences.zh: 在宾夕法尼亚州，这项调查显示只有22%的选民认为经济状况极好或良好。

sentences.en: There's a lot of ground to make up here before the economy starts being anything like an advantage for Harris.
sentences.zh: 在经济问题开始成为哈里斯的优势之前，还有很多工作要做。

sentences.en: Voters have believed for years that the economy was bad.
sentences.zh: 多年来，选民一直认为经济状况很糟糕。

sentences.en: I don't know that they're going to change their views on this very quickly.
sentences.zh: 我不认为他们会很快改变这种看法。

sentences.en: I think we're going to go take an ad break.
sentences.zh: 我想我们要进一段广告了。

sentences.zh: 你想给我们介绍一下吗？

sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.zh: 我是Winnalou。

sentences.zh: 我热爱恐怖电影。

sentences.zh: 我是Sam Mazursky，我每天负责制作《Spelling Bee》和《Letterboxd》游戏。

sentences.zh: 我有一种叫“联觉”的特质。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由真人制作的，就像你们刚才听到的这些人一样。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问nytimes.com/games即可开始游玩。

sentences.en: All right, let's turn to our next piece of business here, which is news of something that kind of sounds like not news,
sentences.zh: 好了，让我们谈谈下一项议题，这则新闻听起来似乎不算新闻，

sentences.en: is because it's the non-endorsement from a very big union in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 因为它是一个美国大型工会做出的“不背书”决定，

sentences.en: with 1.3 million members in the transportation industry.
sentences.zh: 该工会在运输行业拥有130万名成员。

sentences.en: So tell us that story.
sentences.zh: 给我们讲讲这个故事吧。

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: The International Brotherhood of Teamsters, they are in a variety of states across the country, hugely influential, for 30 years endorsed Democrats.
sentences.zh: 国际卡车司机工会（International Brotherhood of Teamsters）在全国各州都有分布，影响力巨大，过去30年来一直支持民主党。

sentences.en: This year, Sean O'Brien, the head of the Teamsters, for his own personal internal political reasons, started flirting with Donald Trump as a possible endorsement.
sentences.zh: 今年，卡车司机工会负责人肖恩·奥布莱恩（Sean O'Brien）出于他个人内部政治原因，开始与唐纳德·特朗普接触，考虑是否支持他。

sentences.en: Why?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: He went to Mar-a-Lago to meet with him.
sentences.zh: 他去了海湖庄园与他会面。

sentences.en: A lot of his members are in southern states, and they are more Republican-leaning, and he is trying to appeal to them and show that he is not just going in one political direction.
sentences.zh: 他的许多成员身处南部各州，更倾向于共和党，他试图争取他们，并表明自己不会只倒向某一个政治方向。

sentences.en: So it is not a surprise that he spoke, say, at the Republican National Convention.
sentences.zh: 所以，他在共和党全国代表大会上发言也就不足为奇了。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Because he had been drifting toward Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 因为他一直在向唐纳德·特朗普靠拢。

sentences.en: Now, his advisors said that he asked to speak at both party conventions.
sentences.zh: 现在，他的顾问们表示，他曾要求在两党的全国代表大会上发言。

sentences.en: The Democrats, after he spoke at the Republican Convention, did not have him, and he gave a pretty aggressive anti-corporate speech at that convention.
sentences.zh: 民主党人在他于共和党大会发言后没有邀请他，而他在那次大会上发表了一番相当激进的反企业演讲。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I was in the room.
sentences.zh: 我当时就在现场。

sentences.en: Yep.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: But nonetheless, it was seen as a boost to Donald Trump because it had tied him to organized labor.
sentences.zh: 但尽管如此，这仍被视为对唐纳德·特朗普的提振，因为它将他与有组织劳工联系在了一起。

sentences.en: And working-class voters.
sentences.zh: 还有蓝领选民。

sentences.en: And working-class voters.
sentences.zh: 还有蓝领选民。

sentences.en: He was a proxy for working-class voters.
sentences.zh: 他成为了蓝领选民的代言人。

sentences.en: And working-class voters.
sentences.zh: 还有蓝领选民。

sentences.en: And the union has now decided not to endorse this cycle.
sentences.zh: 现在该工会决定在这一选举周期不进行背书。

sentences.en: This is, at minimum, a harm to Harris, and it is helpful to Trump to be able to say, as he has been for the last day, rank-and-file members support me.
sentences.zh: 这至少对哈里斯是有害的，而对特朗普来说是有利的，因为他可以像过去一天那样宣称：普通成员支持我。

sentences.en: Now, he said that on Long Island, where the local Teamsters affiliate had actually endorsed Harris.
sentences.zh: 他是在长岛这么说的，而那里的当地卡车司机工会分部实际上已经背书了哈里斯。

sentences.en: But it doesn't matter.
sentences.zh: 但这不重要。

sentences.en: It gives Trump a talking point, and that's the strategy here.
sentences.zh: 这给了特朗普一个谈资，这就是他们的策略。

sentences.en: They didn't exactly peel off the International Brotherhood of Teamsters, but they did get neutral, and that's good enough for them.
sentences.zh: 他们并没有完全拉拢国际卡车司机工会，但确实让他们保持了中立，这对他们来说就足够了。

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, I think it's a reflection of the shifting voting patterns of union members.
sentences.zh: 是的，我的意思是，我认为这反映了工会成员投票模式的转变。

sentences.en: This is union leadership reflecting union members, which is, in some of these trade workers, they are increasingly been for Trump, right?
sentences.zh: 这是工会领导层反映了工会成员的心声，即在某些行业工人中，他们越来越倾向于特朗普，对吧？

sentences.en: They released some of their own internal surveys about where they were.
sentences.zh: 他们发布了一些关于自身立场的内部调查。

sentences.en: Even when Biden was in the race, there was a big chunk in favor, right?
sentences.zh: 即使在拜登还在竞选时，也有很大一部分人支持他，对吧？

sentences.en: So, if you look at union leadership across the country, it's almost universally for Democrats.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你看看全国各地的工会领导层，几乎普遍支持民主党。

sentences.en: This is an exception.
sentences.zh: 这是一个例外。

sentences.en: The exception is a non-endorsement, right?
sentences.zh: 这个例外就是“不背书”，对吧？

sentences.en: Most are not going anywhere near Trump.
sentences.zh: 大多数人根本不会靠近特朗普。

sentences.en: But it's a reflection that the membership has shifted on these issues.
sentences.zh: 但这反映出成员在这些问题上的立场已经发生了转变。

sentences.en: And again, for Trump, that's a win.
sentences.zh: 再说一次，对特朗普来说，这就是一场胜利。

sentences.en: He wants to be making inroads with those voters, and he wants people to have a pass, that it's okay to consider him.
sentences.zh: 他希望在这些选民中取得进展，并希望人们获得一种许可，即考虑支持他是可以接受的。

sentences.en: And I think that that's what helps.
sentences.zh: 我认为这正是起到帮助作用的地方。

sentences.en: Look, it's also a positive for Harris that a person who spoke at the Republican National Convention didn't go all the way to endorsing Trump, right?
sentences.zh: 看，对于哈里斯来说，一个在共和党全国代表大会上发言的人最终没有完全背书特朗普，这也是积极的一面，对吧？

sentences.en: Nate, why does it matter that the Teamsters union has, in effect, de facto,
sentences.zh: 内特，为什么卡车司机工会实际上已经“事实上的”

sentences.en: kind of signaled an affinity for Trump and not given the Democrats what they may have viewed as their kind of birthright, which was the endorsement of such a powerful,
sentences.zh: 表现出对特朗普的亲近，而没有给民主党他们可能视为“与生俱来”的东西——即这样一个强大的、

sentences.en: longtime Democratic-leaning union?
sentences.zh: 长期倾向民主党的工会的背书，这一点很重要？

sentences.en: I want to go back to something Shane said, which is that the Teamsters conducted their own surveys of their members.
sentences.zh: 我想回到肖恩刚才说的一点，即卡车司机工会对他们的成员进行了内部调查。

sentences.en: And previously, they found that most of their members backed Biden, only narrowly.
sentences.zh: 此前，他们发现大多数成员仅以微弱优势支持拜登。

sentences.en: Now, they find their members back Trump over Harris by a wide margin.
sentences.zh: 现在，他们发现成员以较大优势支持特朗普而非哈里斯。

sentences.en: Now, not all of these surveys are scientific.
sentences.zh: 当然，这些调查并非全部都是科学的。

sentences.en: Some of them attempt to be.
sentences.zh: 有些试图做到科学。

sentences.en: Others are just a straw poll.
sentences.zh: 其他的只是民意测验。

sentences.en: But this is part of a larger pattern that we see in our data, which is a further decline in Democratic support among white working class voters since Harris became the nominee.
sentences.zh: 但这只是我们数据中更大趋势的一部分，即自哈里斯成为候选人以来，白人蓝领选民对民主党的支持率进一步下降。

sentences.en: And a group like the Teamsters is suddenly up for grabs.
sentences.zh: 像卡车司机工会这样的组织突然成了争夺的对象。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: This is something of a sharp turn, but I think we do need to talk about the fallout from what happened five days ago.
sentences.zh: 这算是一个急转弯，但我认为我们确实需要谈谈五天前发生的事情所带来的影响。

sentences.en: It feels like it's a lot longer than that.
sentences.zh: 感觉那已经是很久以前的事了。

sentences.en: And that is this second plot to try to kill Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 那就是针对唐纳德·特朗普的第二次暗杀图谋。

sentences.en: And so, I want to ask you all to help us think through what this second attempt means for Trump and what it means for the electorate.
sentences.zh: 所以，我想请大家帮我们理清这第二次暗杀企图对特朗普意味着什么，对选民又意味着什么。

sentences.en: Because we're really dealing with something truly unprecedented.
sentences.zh: 因为我们确实在处理一件真正史无前例的事情。

sentences.en: I mean, I remember seeing the first statement that Kamala Harris put out, which is that violence has no place in this country.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我记得卡玛拉·哈里斯发布的第一份声明，即暴力在这个国家没有立足之地。

sentences.en: And, you know, it just made me think that I'm not sure that's true anymore, that there is increasingly a place where violence is in our country and in our politics.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这让我觉得我不确定那是否还是真的，暴力在我们的国家和政治中正日益占据一席之地。

sentences.en: And when you go back and think through all the different people who are political leaders who have been subjected to violence recently, it's a long liSt.
sentences.zh: 当你回顾并思考最近遭受暴力的所有政治领导人时，那是一个很长的名单。

sentences.en: And, of course, we had the violence on January 6th.
sentences.zh: 当然，我们还有1月6日的暴力事件。

sentences.en: And so, you know, these are horrific things, and they're a reminder that this country isn't that far from violence anymore.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，这些都是可怕的事情，它们提醒我们，这个国家离暴力已经不远了。

sentences.en: Maggie, what's your sense of how Trump personally is handling the fact that two people seem to want to try to kill him in the past two months?
sentences.zh: 玛吉，你觉得特朗普本人是如何看待在过去两个月里有两个人似乎想要暗杀他这一事实的？

sentences.en: How is that affecting him based on your report?
sentences.zh: 根据你的报道，这对他有什么影响？

sentences.en: Is it affecting him?
sentences.zh: 这对他有影响吗？

sentences.en: It's an interesting question, Michael.
sentences.zh: 这是一个有趣的问题，迈克尔。

sentences.en: We got a bit of an answer at the rally on Long Island on Wednesday night.
sentences.zh: 我们在周三晚上的长岛集会上得到了一些答案。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So after the shooting in Butler, Pennsylvania, Trump was clearly in shock, and lots of people around him described him that way.
sentences.zh: 在宾夕法尼亚州巴特勒的枪击事件后，特朗普显然处于震惊之中，他周围的许多人都这样描述他。

sentences.en: And I think he probably still is to some extent.
sentences.zh: 我想他在某种程度上可能仍然如此。

sentences.en: After what happened on Sunday in West Palm Beach, people who talked to him that afternoon and saw him that afternoon said it was as if nothing had happened,
sentences.zh: 在周日西棕榈滩发生的事情之后，那天下午与他交谈并见到他的人说，他表现得好像什么都没发生过一样，

sentences.en: that he just basically resumed life.
sentences.zh: 他基本上恢复了正常生活。

sentences.en: You know, it just became more grist for his storytelling.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这只是成了他讲故事的更多素材。

sentences.en: But he wasn't stuck on it the same way, and he wasn't processing it the same way.
sentences.zh: 但他并没有像以前那样纠结于此，也没有以同样的方式去消化它。

sentences.en: And yet, at his rally, in the middle of an answer about, I don't even remember what, I think it was tax policy or economic policy, you can see on the live stream,
sentences.zh: 然而，在他的集会上，在回答一个问题时——我不记得是什么问题了，我想是税收政策或经济政策——你可以在直播中看到，

sentences.en: if listeners were to watch it, his eyes flicker to his right, and he sees someone moving.
sentences.zh: 如果听众去观看的话，他的眼睛向右闪烁，他看到有人在移动。

sentences.en: And he sort of startles, and he says to the crowd that he thought – essentially, I'm paraphrasing, but he thought somebody was coming up, meaning coming up on stage.
sentences.zh: 他有点受惊，并对人群说他以为——本质上，我是在转述，但他以为有人冲上来了，意思是冲上舞台。

sentences.en: And he said, I thought that I was going to have to get ready to fight, and then jokingly says that he's got a bit of a yip problem.
sentences.zh: 他说，我以为我得准备好战斗了，然后开玩笑说他有点“紧张症”（yip problem）。

sentences.en: Just translate that.
sentences.zh: 翻译一下那个词。

sentences.en: He means anxiety.
sentences.zh: 他的意思是焦虑。

sentences.en: Yip.
sentences.zh: 紧张。

sentences.en: Anxiety.
sentences.zh: 焦虑。

sentences.en: And he's –
sentences.zh: 而且他——

sentences.en: How could you not be constantly looking over your shoulder right now?
sentences.zh: 现在怎么可能不时刻提防着呢？

sentences.en: A hundred percent, as any normal person would do.
sentences.zh: 百分之百，任何正常人都会这么做。

sentences.en: But when have we ever heard Donald Trump say something like that?
sentences.zh: 但我们什么时候听过唐纳德·特朗普说出那样的话？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: A vulnerability expression is not his natural state.
sentences.zh: 表达脆弱并不是他的常态。

sentences.en: It's not his natural state at all.
sentences.zh: 这根本不是他的常态。

sentences.en: And so to hear him vocalize that and to see it in real time was pretty striking.
sentences.zh: 所以听到他表达出来并实时看到这一幕，相当令人震惊。

sentences.en: Now, there was a moment in the 2016 campaign where someone rushed the stage when he was speaking.
sentences.zh: 在2016年的竞选活动中，确实曾有人在他演讲时冲上舞台。

sentences.en: I remember that.
sentences.zh: 我记得那件事。

sentences.en: You remember that at an event?
sentences.zh: 你记得那次活动吗？

sentences.en: He sort of ducked.
sentences.zh: 他当时躲了一下。

sentences.en: That was his impulse.
sentences.zh: 那是他的本能反应。

sentences.en: That was the only time I've ever seen anything close.
sentences.zh: 那是我唯一一次看到类似的情况。

sentences.en: This was really somebody who is on high alert right now.
sentences.zh: 这次确实是一个现在处于高度戒备状态的人。

sentences.en: And so even if he is not saying, yes, I'm worried, yes, this is scary, because he will never say something like that, he clearly is and is clearly experiencing it.
sentences.zh: 所以即使他没有说“是的，我很担心，是的，这很可怕”，因为他永远不会说那样的话，但他显然很担心，并且显然正在经历这种情绪。

sentences.en: Very understandably.
sentences.zh: 非常可以理解。

sentences.en: Nate, when we think about these back-to-back plots, how do you try to assess the way voters think about it?
sentences.zh: 内特，当我们思考这些接连发生的阴谋时，你如何评估选民对此的看法？

sentences.en: I don't think we have asked people in polls about this, but just knowing what you know about how the electorate processes things, what are you thinking?
sentences.zh: 我不认为我们在民调中问过人们这个问题，但仅凭你对选民处理事情方式的了解，你怎么看？

sentences.en: We haven't asked a single question about it, to your point.
sentences.zh: 正如你所说，我们甚至没问过一个相关的问题。

sentences.en: And what would we ask, really, if you think about it?
sentences.zh: 而且如果你仔细想想，我们又能问什么呢？

sentences.en: But if you step back for a second, take the long view of Donald Trump's political career.
sentences.zh: 但如果你退后一步，从长远角度审视唐纳德·特朗普的政治生涯。

sentences.en: Donald Trump today is more popular than he has ever been before.
sentences.zh: 今天的唐纳德·特朗普比他以往任何时候都更受欢迎。

sentences.en: Back in 2016, voters disliked him by nearly a two-to-one margin.
sentences.zh: 回到2016年，选民对他的反感程度几乎是支持程度的两倍。

sentences.en: This year, it's much closer to 50-50, because almost all of the people who support him today have gotten behind him.
sentences.zh: 今年，情况更接近五五开，因为今天支持他的几乎所有人都坚定地站在了他身后。

sentences.en: And I wouldn't rule out a role for these assassination attempts in that process.
sentences.zh: 我不会排除这些暗杀企图在这一过程中所起的作用。

sentences.en: Consider this.
sentences.zh: 考虑一下这个。

sentences.en: In the nine national polls that we took this cycle before his assassination attempt, between 21 and 24 percent of voters said they had a very favorable view of him.
sentences.zh: 在我们这个周期暗杀企图发生前进行的九次全国民调中，有21%到24%的选民表示对他有非常好的看法。

sentences.en: Since the assassination attempt, the numbers are 31, 27, 30.
sentences.zh: 暗杀企图发生后，数字变成了31、27、30。

sentences.en: So there has been a big step up in the proportion of voters who say they have a very favorable view of him.
sentences.zh: 所以，表示对他有非常好的看法的选民比例有了大幅提升。

sentences.en: Those reluctant Trump supporters over the years, a lot more of them are less reluctant.
sentences.zh: 那些多年来勉强支持特朗普的人，现在有更多人不再那么勉强了。

sentences.en: And then there's an overall increase in favorability as well, where now he's consistently in the upper 40,
sentences.zh: 而且整体好感度也有所增加，现在他稳定在40%以上，

sentences.en: something we had never seen in the course of his time as a major figure in national political life.
sentences.zh: 这是我们在他作为国家政治生活重要人物期间从未见过的。

sentences.en: I mean, Nate, you've touched just on something that I think is really interesting about what my expectations were for how this election was going to go.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，内特，你刚才提到的这一点，我认为对于我之前对这次选举走向的预期来说，真的很有趣。

sentences.en: Not just because it was originally going to be Trump and Biden, but it was going to be two deeply unpopular people that the American people did not want to send to the White House.
sentences.zh: 不仅仅是因为最初是特朗普对阵拜登，而是因为当时是两个极不受欢迎的人，美国人民并不想把他们送进白宫。

sentences.en: And that's just not what the polling is showing anymore.
sentences.zh: 但民调显示的情况已不再是那样了。

sentences.en: It shows with all the attack ads running against Kamala Harris that she is more popular than she's been before.
sentences.zh: 民调显示，尽管有所有针对卡玛拉·哈里斯的攻击性广告，她还是比以前更受欢迎了。

sentences.en: And Donald Trump is more popular than he's been before.
sentences.zh: 而唐纳德·特朗普也比以前更受欢迎。

sentences.en: You have two people in the upper 40s sometimes tipping at 50 percent.
sentences.zh: 你有两个人的支持率都在40%以上，有时甚至达到50%。

sentences.en: That's really popular right now in this country.
sentences.zh: 在这个国家，这现在真的很受欢迎。

sentences.en: Like we've had people in the 30s, in the 40s.
sentences.zh: 就像我们以前有过支持率在30%多、40%多的人。

sentences.en: So we actually have a shifting dynamic of what voters are thinking about these choices.
sentences.zh: 所以我们实际上正在经历选民对这些选择看法的动态转变。

sentences.en: They don't dislike these choices nearly as much as we expected a few months ago.
sentences.zh: 他们并不像我们几个月前预期的那样反感这些选择。

sentences.en: That's very true.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: And 2024 was beginning to look like a replay of 2016 where there were these two deeply disliked candidates and it was going to be whoever was less disliked ended up winning.
sentences.zh: 2024年原本看起来像是2016年的重演，当时有两位极不受欢迎的候选人，谁更不招人讨厌谁就能赢。

sentences.en: That's still usually how elections work.
sentences.zh: 选举通常还是这样运作的。

sentences.en: But if there is an election that could scramble that, it could be this one.
sentences.zh: 但如果有一场选举能打破这种局面，那可能就是这一场。

sentences.en: Well, guys, that's it.
sentences.zh: 好了，各位，就是这样了。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: A historic first of a roundtable in America.
sentences.zh: 这是美国历史上首次圆桌会议。

sentences.en: That was fun.
sentences.zh: 这很有趣。

sentences.en: Thank you, Michael.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，迈克尔。

sentences.en: Thanks for having us.
sentences.zh: 感谢邀请我们。

sentences.en: You know, when they set up the exhibit in the Museum of Media History, I'm going to be really proud to be in that photograph.
sentences.zh: 你知道，当他们在媒体历史博物馆布置展览时，我会为能出现在那张照片里感到非常自豪。

sentences.en: Thank you for having us.
sentences.zh: 感谢邀请我们。

sentences.en: This was fun.
sentences.zh: 这很有趣。

sentences.en: Thank you, Nate, Maggie, Shane.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你们，内特、玛吉、肖恩。

sentences.en: Appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 感激不尽。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Thanks, Michael.
sentences.zh: 谢谢，迈克尔。

sentences.en: Let's do it again.
sentences.zh: 我们再来一次吧。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是今天你需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: On Thursday, the leader of Hezbollah accused Israel of breaking, quote,
sentences.zh: 周四，真主党领导人指责以色列打破了，引用原话，

sentences.en: All conventions and laws by blowing up thousands of handheld devices belonging to Hezbollah fighters over the past two days and vowed to seek revenge.
sentences.zh: 所有公约和法律，在过去两天里炸毁了数千台属于真主党武装人员的手持设备，并誓言要寻求报复。

sentences.en: As he spoke, Israeli fighter jets flew overhead, producing large sonic booms and shooting off flares in an apparent show of Israeli force.
sentences.zh: 在他讲话时，以色列战斗机从头顶飞过，制造出巨大的音爆并射出照明弹，显然是在展示以色列的武力。

sentences.en: So far, the attacks have killed 37 people, most of them in the second wave of explosions targeting walkie-talkies.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，这些袭击已造成37人死亡，其中大多数是在针对对讲机的第二波爆炸中丧生的。

sentences.en: To prevent further deaths, the Lebanese army is now carrying out controlled explosions of electronic devices across the country.
sentences.zh: 为了防止更多人死亡，黎巴嫩军队目前正在全国范围内对电子设备进行受控引爆。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Diana Nguyen and Nina Feldman.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由戴安娜·阮和尼娜·费尔德曼制作。
zh_words: 戴安娜·阮和尼娜·费尔德曼

sentences.en: It was edited by Rachel Quester, with help from Paige Coward.
sentences.zh: 由瑞秋·奎斯特编辑，佩奇·考沃德提供协助。

sentences.en: Contains original music by Pat McCusker, Alicia Ba-Etoop, and Dan Powell.
sentences.zh: 包含帕特·麦卡斯克、艾丽西亚·巴-埃图普和丹·鲍威尔的原创音乐。

sentences.en: And was engineered by Chris Wood.
sentences.zh: 由克里斯·伍德进行工程制作。

sentences.en: Our theme music is by Jim Brunberg and Ben Lansford of Wonderly.
sentences.zh: 我们的主题音乐由Wonderly的吉姆·布伦伯格和本·兰斯福德创作。

sentences.en: Remember, you can catch a new episode of The Interview right here tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 记住，明天你可以在这里收听新一期的《访谈》节目。

sentences.en: David Marchese talks with the Irish writer Sally Rooney, who's written a new novel called Intermezzo.
sentences.zh: 大卫·马尔凯塞将与爱尔兰作家萨莉·鲁尼交谈，她写了一部名为《插曲》的新小说。

sentences.en: One of the things that I find difficult to accept is that I only get one life.
sentences.zh: 我发现很难接受的一件事是，我只有这一辈子。

sentences.en: That's it.
sentences.zh: 就是这样。

sentences.en: I'm just me.
sentences.zh: 我只是我。

sentences.en: And I can never be anyone else.
sentences.zh: 而且我永远无法成为别人。

sentences.en: And in a way, being a novelist allows me to get around that problem.
sentences.zh: 在某种程度上，成为一名小说家让我能够绕过这个问题。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 《每日新闻》到此结束。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you on Monday.
sentences.zh: 周一见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》，我们正在为假期接待客人做准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 敬请收听，获取让客人宾至如归的秘诀。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们需要全黑的睡眠环境吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是不是喝断片了才去睡觉。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们需要什么样的光线？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为那是非常具体的要求。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们是喝咖啡还是喝茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 在《纽约时报》应用程序或你喜欢的任何平台上收听《Wirecutter秀》。
